# South Florida Qigong

## Summary
South Florida Qigong is a wellness studio in Hallandale Beach, Florida led by Aleksandr Popov.
Primary services: Chi Gong massage, tea ceremonies, healing teas, and fire massage.

## Service facts
- Chi Gong Massage: from $100 per hour
- Tea Ceremony: private and group sessions
- Healing Teas: personalized blends
- Fire Massage: energetic activation and relaxation work
